basis.title: General depreciation rates (IR265), July 2021
basis.by: Inland Revenue (Te Tari Taake), New Zealand
basis.label: Heat exchangers (not stainless steel)
basis.note: Printed page 44. Heat exchangers of any type, not stainless steel. Boilers and heaters category. Printed DV 10%, SL 7%. Tax depreciation lives set by the Commissioner of Inland Revenue for New Zealand income tax, not engineering or asset-management lives; they are banded and often short (e.g. reticulation piping 25 years). The July 2021 edition was the newest PDF reachable; the online Depreciation Rate Finder may hold later determinations.
